description: This file defines the CompareCondition class, which implements a conditional comparison operation for a mini-language within the OFBiz framework. It handles parsing, evaluating, and executing comparison logic based on XML configuration, supporting nested sub-operations and artifact gathering.

classes.name: CompareCondition
classes.description: Implements a comparison-based conditional operation for the mini-language, supporting nested sub-operations and evaluation logic.

classes.name: CompareCondition.CompareConditionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of CompareCondition from XML elements.

methods.name: CompareCondition
methods.description: Constructor that parses XML element to initialize comparison condition.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates the comparison condition based on current method context.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes sub-operations based on the evaluation of the condition.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information from nested operations.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Generates a human-readable representation of the condition.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the XML element for debugging.
